integrity: One analytical claim across the result, review, and verification; numerical diagnostics are illustrative only.
scientific_limitations: Independently unvalidated; the resistance method is classical and possible implicit coverage by a more general one-dimensional capacity theorem remains. Numerical shooting checks finite cases and does not certify infinite limits.
scientific_scope: Sharp weighted Poincaré spectral gap and eigenfunction/derivative-energy profiles for positive symmetric increasing one-dimensional power-law weights near an internal degenerate interface; no general nonmonotone or multidimensional assertion.
title: Sharp resistance-controlled spectral collapse and a critical eigenfunction profile for symmetric weighted Poincaré inequalities
